game.title: Draughts Naija
game.howto.1: The light (ivory) pieces are yours and start at the bottom. Tap a piece, then tap a marked square to move it. You can drag it too. Pieces move one square diagonally forward.
game.howto.2: Capture is compulsory. Jump over an enemy piece into the empty square behind it. Men capture forwards and backwards. A piece that can capture shows a warning triangle.
game.howto.3: On 10x10 you must take the most pieces you can in one move (the majority rule). On 8x8 this is a switch on the Rules page, on by default. Jumps carry on in a chain and the numbered stones show your path. A piece cannot be jumped twice, and captured pieces leave the board only when the whole move is done.
game.howto.4: Reach the far row to become a king. On 10x10 a king flies along a diagonal, any distance, and captures from far away. A man that passes the far row in the middle of a capture and keeps jumping is not crowned.
game.howto.5: If several captures end on the same square, tap the numbered stone where the paths part to choose one.
game.howto.6: You win when the other side has no pieces or no move. The same position three times, or 25 moves each with only kings and no capture, is a draw.
game.howto.7: Pick 10x10 (international) or 8x8 (short game) on the menu. Stuck? Tap Hint. On a keyboard use the arrow keys, Enter, Escape, H for a hint and P to pause. The Rules page has the switches for 8x8 and for who starts.
rules.title: Rules
rules.intro: 10x10 always follows the international rules. The switches below change the 8x8 short game and who starts. The computer follows the same rules as you.
rules.draws: A draw: the same position three times, or 25 moves each with only kings moving and no capture.
rules.max.help: On: you must play the capture that takes the most pieces. Off: any capture is allowed. 10x10 always takes the most.
rules.fly.help: On: a king slides and captures from any distance. Off: a king moves one square. 10x10 kings always fly.
rules.cpuStarts.help: On: the computer (dark) makes the first move. Off: you (light) start.
rules.fast.help: Pieces slide and the computer thinks about 1.7 times quicker.
